pass_condition: Every fact the ScoreRecord carries that a consumer needs survives the store boundary.

findings.statement: GateResult.undecided (the decision ids a gate could not decide) has no column and is dropped on write, so an undecided gate is unexplainable from the database.
findings.failure_scenario: A repo whose D-GATE evaluation returned undecided=('D-GATE-3',) is stored as eligible with no trace of the undecided decision; the API can only report eligible/gate_reason/routed, and the 'why is this repo ranked despite an undecided gate' question has no answer in the store. W2-2 explicitly records UNDECIDED gates by decision id.

observations: The packet flagged this itself under COULD NOT VERIFY, which is the right disclosure; the point is that it should be a one-column addition (gate_undecided TEXT DEFAULT '[]'), not a deferral, since the schema was already extended twice for 06 section 4.

Also unstored: ScoreRecord.provenance_hash and ScoreRecord.tie_key. provenance_hash is partially recoverable from params.source_hash and 03 section 5 requires only snapshot_id/raw_hash/constants_hash, so this is a note, not a defect; tie_key is recomputable.

not_checked.statement: W4-3's persona re-projection SQL and W4-4's endpoints are not in this packet; only the reader helpers they build on were checked.
